description: This file provides a utility function 'apiGet' for making HTTP GET requests with centralized URL handling, including base URL resolution, organization ID appending, and logging. It also exports the 'apiGet' function as part of the default export.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl
methods.description: Determines the base API URL from configuration, environment variables, or defaults to '/api'.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Joins a base URL and a path, handling special cases like URLs containing /api.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl
methods.description: Appends organization_id or tenant_id to the URL if not already present.

methods.name: apiGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL or path, with URL resolution, organization ID appending, headers setup, and response handling.
